news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹9.35 (vs ₹7.36 in FY 2025)

news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.0% a week. This is considered a minor risk.
